scope: Two additive source/review files only. This unit provides hosted actual-import controls; it grants no execution authority.

required_integration.native_flags_may_be_typed_false_or_futur: The unchanged execution adapter methods() checks the whole authority schema; this checker does not require or grant native authority.
required_integration.worker_qualification: The runtime requires the actual two-edit worker bytes and protected hash; reconstruction was used only during source authorship. Base825 still has the original aa04 worker and must fail this checker until root integrates the exact successor.

actual_import_projection.exact_maps: Checker EXPECTED and DATA contain every path, byte count and SHA256. closure() derives the current graph and authenticates unchanged original recipe-reader AST/line/digest guards.
actual_import_projection.isolated_execution: Actual sys.executable -I -B child with only the exact55 temporary files, scripts path explicitly inserted, exact NumPy2.3.3 preloaded. Four actual entries imported; no numerical main invoked.
actual_import_projection.loaded_file_gate: Every loaded repository module must be one of the exact52 pinned files, no duplicate or missing module records; every file is rehashed. Worker/stage admission identity and stage result identity must match actual imported modules.
actual_import_projection.isolated_tree_gate: Before/after full file map equality, no generated output tree, no bytecode files; all deliberate missing/tampered fixture files restored before final exact map check.

dependency_findings.deferred_native_imports: Some inherited functions reference odb, pya or sg13g2; these functions are not called during these import controls.
dependency_findings.platform: Intended hosted Ubuntu24.04/Python3.12. NumPy2.3.3 must be installed before this checker; stage/context preflight itself remains stdlib-only.

positive_cases: actual four-entry isolated import with module hashes and identity checks
refusal_cases: missing current execution adapter actual ModuleNotFoundError
missing original recipe actual FileNotFoundError at frozen reader frame
tampered original recipe actual hash AssertionError at frozen reader frame
write audit event refused before effect
subprocess.Popen audit event refused before effect
socket.connect audit event refused before effect
authored_controls.records: Complete child stdout, stderr and returncode included for the positive child and all six refusal children; no stream truncation. Synthetic filesystem fault injection is confined to hosted temporary source copies. No native inputs or network are needed.
authored_controls.failure_report: FAIL_WIDTH_LOADED_ACTUAL_IMPORT_SOURCE_CONTROLS with full traceback; output/console errors do not replace an already captured primary.

audit_policy.scope: A behavioral guard around authenticated imports, not a general Python security sandbox. NumPy and standard libraries are loaded before the hook is active.
audit_policy.denied: OS process execution/spawn/fork, socket connect/bind, filesystem mutation events, and open write flags/modes. Guard refusal controls raise before the requested side effect.
audit_policy.normal_imports: Generic compile/exec audit events are intentionally allowed because CPython executes imported module code with exec. os.exec remains forbidden.

boundaries: The unchanged original55-module checker is historical and does not qualify the new execution worker.
The authoring branch intentionally has no workflow or native authority and is not directly runnable as the execution branch.
Root must integrate the exact ebf worker, protected checker/review pins and an authenticated hosted source-only workflow, then run these controls.
